text: ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto ye dhammā abhiññā pariññeyyā te dhammā abhiññā parijānāti ye dhammā abhiññā pahātabbā te dhamme abhiññā pajahati ye dhammā abhiññā sacchikātabbā te dhamme abhiññā sacchikaroti ye dhammā abhiññā bhāvetabbā te dhamme abhiññā bhāveti . [291] katame ca bhikkhave dhammā abhiññā pariññeyyā . pañcupādānakkhandhātissa vacanīyaṃ . katame pañca . seyyathīdaṃ . rūpūpādānakkhandho .pe. viññāṇūpādānakkhandho . ime bhikkhave dhammā abhiññā
